questions.prompt: The formula for the nth term of a geometric sequence is $a_n = a_1 \cdot r^{___}$.
hints: The exponent involves the position number $n$.
The first term has no factor of $r$, so the exponent is 0 when $n=1$.
questions.feedbackIfWrong: The exponent is $n-1$, so the formula is $a_n = a_1 \cdot r^{n-1}$.

questions.prompt: A geometric sequence has $a_1 = 3$ and $r = 2$. Find $a_4$.
hints: Use the formula $a_n = a_1 \cdot r^{n-1}$.
